items.q: What is a test automation platform?
items.a: A test automation platform runs automated tests at scale and reports results. TestMu AI provides the browsers, real devices, parallelism and debugging artifacts so teams do not run their own grid.

items.q: Which frameworks does TestMu AI support?
items.a: Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer, Appium, Espresso and XCUITest, in Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, Ruby and other languages.

items.q: Do I have to rewrite my tests?
items.a: No. Existing suites run after you change the remote URL and capabilities.

items.q: Can I test applications behind a firewall?
items.a: Yes. A secure tunnel lets cloud browsers and devices reach localhost, staging and internal apps.

items.q: How much does the test automation platform cost?
items.a: The free plan gives 100 lifetime minutes with 2 parallel sessions. Web Automation on desktop starts at $79 per month, billed annually.
